documents.name: Procurement_Savings_Program_2026-27.pdf
documents.excerpt:
PROCUREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAM · 1 JULY 2026 TO 30 JUNE 2027
Sponsor: Ellis Hargrove · Lead: Tolu Adeyemi

Target: 2.5% of addressable capital spend. Baseline $968.0M (the FY27 addressable spend in the plan), so $24.2M.
Levers: framework compliance, renegotiation, re-bids, specification changes, volume consolidation.
A saving counts once it is in an order or a signed contract. Reported monthly in the savings tracker.
